decision: Retain a version-limited first-party TRI-X MTF source prior for future separately gated spatial-response comparisons.
claim_ceiling: First-party vector extraction of an older TRI-X Pan 5063 D-76 large-tank diffuse-visual MTF curve whose applicability to newer films is preliminary; not a current-400TX measurement, density-conditioned MTF, scanner response, photographic calibration or product authority.
